assertion.text: Erdős Problem #614: declared status 'open'. Formalized: no. Let $f(n,k)$ be minimal such that there is a graph with $n$ vertices and $f(n,k)$ edges where every set of $k+2$ vertices induces a subgraph with maximum degree at least $k$. Determine $f(n,k)$. Prize: no. Tags: graph theory.
